title: The Singular Fibration of Collapsing RCD Spaces with Reifenberg Local Covers
summary: Let compact $\mathrm{RCD}(κ,N)$ spaces converge in the measured Gromov--Hausdorff sense, and suppose that they have $(δ,ρ)$-Reifenberg local covers for one fixed $ρ>0$, with $|κ|ρ^2\le1$ and $δ$ small. We prove that, along a subsequence, the spaces are singular fibrations over the limit: their canonical frame spaces converge to a topological manifold with a locally linear action of $O(n)$ whose quotient is the limit; for large indices the frame spaces fibre over this manifold, by maps that commute with $O(n)$, with fibres homeomorphic to nilmanifolds; and the induced maps to the limit are,…
